title: Card Kit Ordering Limits and Delivery Times for Paystride Payroll Card Program Employers
content:
Card kit orders under the Paystride Payroll Card Program are bounded by a minimum order, an order multiple, a ceiling on unissued kits held, and a number of employer locations kits may ship to; each package also states its shipping times.

| Package | Smallest kit order (kits) | Orders placed in multiples of (kits) | Most unissued kits held across locations, counting the order (kits) | Employer locations kits may ship to | Business days to ship a standard order | Business days for expedited delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 25 | 25 | 100 | 1 | 5 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 25 | 25 | 150 | 2 | 5 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 50 | 25 | 300 | 5 | 3 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 50 | 25 | 600 | 10 | 3 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 100 | 25 | 1500 | 25 | 2 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 100 | 25 | 5000 | 100 | 2 | 2 |

### Desk reference points

- The ceiling on unissued kits counts the kits already held at the employer's locations together with the kits of the order.
- A standard order ships within the stated business days; an expedited order arrives within the stated business days.
- Every package orders in multiples of 25 kits, above its smallest order.

Hypothetical reading: under the Select package an order of 125 kits meets the smallest order of 50 and the multiple of 25; an order of 110 kits is not a multiple of 25. A hypothetical Advantage employer already holding 560 unissued kits may hold at most 600 counting the order, so an order of 50 kits would bring the count to 610.
